text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated QPS from org 'Meridian Systems' hitting inference cluster 12 and increasing tail latency > 1s. Error rate rising on embeddings route. Paging #oncall (ashley_oncall).
ashley_oncall: I'm on it. pulling graphs now — looks like sustained 3x above normal for the past 3m. pods 12a/12b CPU spiking, some 500s in app logs. tagging ken_srelead.
ken_srelead: thanks. first thing: can we apply an org-specific temporary rate limit bump to avoid bulk token failures, and concurrently throttle their non-critical endpoints (embeddings/long-context)? want to avoid pool-wide autoscaling.
maya_cs: FYI Meridian is mid-enterprise, currently running a large nightly batch that misfired. They've been paged. they asked for anything that keeps them online — they prefer transient fix + followup.
owen_infra: I can issue a targeted RL change. Suggest bump quota from 1k qps -> 2.5k qps for 30m while we validate. also will add a temporary token-cost cap so we don't blow cost limits.
ashley_oncall: do it. post the command you run so we have audit.
ops-bot: running dry-run...
ops-bot: Executing: ```/rl adjust --org "meridian" --qps 2500 --scope org --duration 30m --reason "emergency spike mitigation 2545006789"```
ops-bot: API ack ok, applying change to edge rate limiter config.
ops-bot: Result: success. previous=1000 qps, new=2500 qps, change_id=chg_2545006795.
ken_srelead: good — while that's in flight, enable per-route shaping on embeddings: cap parallel calls and queue bursts. owen_infra can you push rule?
owen_infra: pushed shaping rule to envoy pool-of-12: ```route_match: /v1/embeddings -> concurrency_limit: 20, burst_buffer: 50, queue_timeout_ms: 500``` change_id=env_2545006801
lia_product: heads-up: disable non-essential features for Meridian (re-ranker and similarity-search prefetch) to reduce background load — toggle off for 1h.
ops-bot: toggling feature flags: ```/feature toggle --org meridian --flag reranker --off --duration 1h``` -> done change_id=ff_2545006808
ashley_oncall: monitoring latency and 5xx around the change. linking dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/cluster12?org=meridian
ken_srelead: also set temporary quota billing alert so finance isn't surprised: create ticket. maya_cs can you prep a quick note to Meridian explaining transient fix and follow-up? include expected duration and rollback path.
maya_cs: drafting now, will send once we confirm stability.
ashley_oncall: metrics update after RL bump + shaping: QPS dropped to target within 60s, 5xx down 70%, tail latency back to 300-400ms. CPU on 12a trending down.
ken_srelead: excellent. let's keep the bump for 30m and re-evaluate. assign follow-up actions: - create incident (postmortem) - add guardrail to detect runaway batch jobs per-org - run root-cause with Meridian ops team - ensure permanent quotas reflect usage patterns if needed
ashley_oncall: filing incident ticket now: INC-2545006815. linking to thread.
ops-bot: Note: audit log entry created chg_2545006795, env_2545006801, ff_2545006808.
owen_infra: small rollback test: reducing RL to 1500 to simulate gradual ramp down in 10m. running: ```/rl adjust --org "meridian" --qps 1500 --duration 10m --change-parent chg_2545006795``` -> success.
ashley_oncall: after ramp, metrics hold. no spike. queueing next rollback to original at T+40m unless we see anomalies.
ken_srelead: add a temporary circuit-breaker for any single user token from Meridian that issues >50 req/s sustained for 60s — to stop hot actors. can we enforce at edge?
owen_infra: yes, implemented token-based CB rule on CDN edge, rule_id cb_2545006827.
lia_product: can we schedule a postmortem meeting 24-48h with Meridian and product + cs + infra. I'll own invites.
maya_cs: pinging Meridian with current status and mitigation summary. will include rollback window and ask them to hold large batches for 2 hours.
ashley_oncall: closing loop: keeping thread open until full rollback at 2545006834. leaving notes for follow-up. thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: change chg_2545006795 auto-expire scheduled at +30m unless extended.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation successful, customer impact reduced to informational only. severity -> reduced. Recommended: postmortem & quota guardrails.
ashley_oncall: marking incident as handoff to follow-up owners: ken_srelead (postmortem), lia_product (customer sync), owen_infra (rate-limiter improvements), maya_cs (customer comms).
ashley_oncall: final action: rolling Meridian RL back to baseline 1000 now as it's within expected usage. ```/rl adjust --org "meridian" --qps 1000 --duration permanent --reason "post-mitigation rollback"``` -> success change_id=chg_2545006834
ken_srelead: recorded. we'll draft postmortem and include action items and timeline.
maya_cs: Meridian acknowledged and will schedule joint RCA. thanks all.
